finding.title: MCP confirmation requirements are not enforced by inspected Unchain conversion
finding.assessment: SQLite create_table is explicitly confirmation-required in PuPu catalog, but actual converted tool is not. Deny callback was never called and a synthetic table was created. Filesystem directory creation also executed without confirmation. This is a host integration failure; no claim that the upstream packages are malware.

limitations: No live isolated PuPu model run with hostile tool/document output was performed.

No real service credentials, private workspace, production database or host browser session were used.

The sandbox denies network and user-home reads except explicit trusted Python/Node runtime paths; writes are restricted to synthetic fixtures. It is not a VM or a complete Mach-service/syscall monitor.
API acquisition and hosted MCP probes use the trusted verifier outside candidate sandbox; hosted backend code is not observable.
Package integrity hashes and reachable Git commits do not establish signed provenance or a complete publisher/build chain.
